annotations.title: Find a Docmint tool for a task

description: Match a plain-language PDF or image task (for example "make this PDF under 2 MB", "turn these photos into one PDF", "remove the password") to the best Docmint tools. Returns up to 5 matches with their id, a ready link and the settings each accepts. Use it when the person wants to do something to a PDF or image and you don't know which tool fits. It does not receive, open or change any file.

task.description: What the person wants to do, in their words.
